summary: Unlock the secrets of financial statement analysis with our advanced course. Gain essential skills to interpret data and drive business success effectively.
lede: Advanced financial statement analysis helps experienced finance professionals interpret disclosures and evaluate an organization's performance, liquidity and risk. Designed for their practical work, the course covers assessing earnings quality and cash flows, applying profitability frameworks and credit-risk models, and building valuation and forecasting analyses.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for experienced finance professionals who require a deeper technical understanding of financial disclosures to support high-level organizational strategy.
modules: Earnings Quality and Revenue Recognition Analysis
Cash Flow Dynamics and Liquidity Assessment
Credit Risk Modeling and Solvency Analysis
Forensic Accounting and Financial Red Flags
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of basic accounting principles (balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements). Experience in financial modeling using Microsoft Excel is required. No prior programming knowledge is necessary, though familiarity with IFRS or GAAP is highly recommended.
